bio: Afternoon Tea Awards 2023 Winner - Best Themed Afternoon Tea   The Berkeley London is a luxury hotel in Knightsbridge that has delighted guests with its welcoming atmosphere and sense of style for over a hundred years.  Afternoon Tea is served in The Collins Room, which is a light-filled, contemporary and charming space named as a tribute to the legendary designer David Collins. The room has been inventively reimagined by Collins' protégé and creative director for 15 years, Robert Angell, who worked with the British architects, Rogers Stirk Harbour & Partners, to mastermind the glass extension to the room. The Collins Room now provides guests with suitably stylish surroundings to indulge in The Berkeley London's award-winning Prêt-à-Portea.  This unique Afternoon Tea experience will wow guests with its beautifully crafted sweet treats inspired by the themes and colours of the fashion world. The menu is transformed every six months to follow the changing seasons in fashion.  The Berkeley London is perfectly located in the heart of an exclusive area of the Capital, just minutes from the desirable Knightsbridge shops and Buckingham Palace.
